market.what: Polyether polyols for flexible foam (what recycled polyol replaces), world
market.method: ~5.4 Mt/yr x ~$1.6/kg (est.) = $8.6B; matches $8.66B report; total polyether capacity 14.5 Mt
market.job_what: chemical recycling (glycolysis/acidolysis) of PU foam into polyol, processing spend, world
market.job_method: est.: ~20 kt/yr foam chemically recycled (Rampf ~5 kt + 3.5 kt, Repsol 2 kt, Dow Renuva ~200k mattresses, others est.) x ~$1.5/kg processing (est.) = ~$30M; low confidence

value.logic: PU 18 Mt/yr, ~25% flexible foam. Recycle 1 Mt EoL foam/yr x 0.6 t polyol/t x ($1.6 virgin - $0.8 process, est.) = $0.48B + $100/t landfill/incineration avoided = $0.1B
value.revenue_logic: 15% of 1 Mt foam = 90 kt polyol x $1.6/kg x 4% royalty = $5.8M + catalyst 1 wt% x 150 kt x $5/kg = $7.5M

trend.drivers: EU: 30M mattresses/yr EoL (60% landfilled); ELV recycled-plastic targets (mass balance OK); EPR for furniture/mattresses; brand recycled-content goals
trend.deadline: EU ELV Regulation: 15% recycled plastic in new cars 6 yrs after entry into force (deal Dec 2025)

competition.notes: Majors own it; Repsol 2 kt/yr plant (EUR 12M, 2024); Evonik/Toyotsu/Sanyo Japan initiative Oct 2026. Patent filings 28 (2021) -> 96 (2024). No funded catalyst startup found

lab.synth: Catalog or 1-2 step organocatalyst/metal carboxylate, 3 variants
lab.test: Glycolysis/acidolysis of shredded mattress foam in lab reactor; polyol OH value ASTM D4274, viscosity ASTM D4878, amine content, GPC; re-foam box foam + ASTM D3574; university/PU lab
lab.logic: Catalysts 3-5 wk, $8k; depolymerization runs + polyol analytics 5 wk, ~$15k; re-foam + D3574 2 wk, ~$7k

sale.gates: Pilot campaign with recycler 6-12 mo; foamer qualifies recycled polyol 6-12 mo; mattress/auto OEM acceptance
